findings.title: CSP connect-src missing forms.example.com
findings.problem: ContactForm posts to https://forms.example.com; the CSP blocks it and the form fails silently.
findings.fix: Append https://forms.example.com to connect-src on line 41.
findings.evidence: screenshots/contact-375-submit.png; console: Refused to connect to 'https://forms.example.com' (connect-src)
findings.verify: csp_hosts.py exits 0 and the form submits with no CSP error at 1440 and 375 px

findings.title: /work/[slug] drops og:image
findings.problem: generateMetadata sets openGraph: { title } without spreading the defaults. Next.js shallow-merges openGraph, so the layout's og:image is gone on every case study.
findings.evidence: curl http://localhost:3000/work/harbor | grep og:image → no match; screenshots/share-preview-work-harbor.png
findings.verify: og:image present on all 6 /work/* pages; smoke_test.py og check passes

findings.title: Privacy policy link points to a placeholder
findings.problem: The consent checkbox links to /privacy, which renders 'Privacy policy — TBD'. Collecting form data without a policy is not launchable.
findings.fix: Publish the client's privacy policy at /privacy.
findings.verify: launch_content.py exits 0; /privacy shows the final policy

findings.title: Staging robots.txt allows indexing
findings.problem: robots.ts returns allow: / regardless of environment; staging.example.com is indexable.

findings.title: Hero video is 14 MB on mobile
findings.problem: The same 1080p MP4 is served at 375 px; LCP on mobile is 4.1 s.
findings.fix: Add a 720p source with media="(max-width: 768px)" and a poster image.
findings.evidence: lighthouse mobile: LCP 4.1 s; network: hero.mp4 14.2 MB

findings.title: Staging sends hits to the production GA property
findings.problem: NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_ID is the production ID in every environment.
findings.fix: Set a staging measurement ID on the host, or skip gtag unless SITE_ENV is production.
findings.verify: staging browser pass shows no hits to the production ID

findings.title: Default Next.js favicon still in place
findings.fix: Replace with the brand mark in 32 px and add apple-icon.png.
findings.evidence: launch_content.py: favicon.ico matches the create-next-app hash

findings.title: Footer link contrast 4.2:1
findings.problem: text-neutral-500 on neutral-900 is 4.2:1, just under AA for small text.

findings.title: Duplicate date formatter
findings.problem: formatDate duplicates Intl logic already in src/lib/date.ts.
